$comment: Reach text library (2026-11-27). Hook-first titles and captions, a CTA, live/community lines and hashtags per platform and clip kind. Used by services/posting/reach-text.mjs: the base of every post's text; the local model only adapts it lightly (ai-text.mjs) and the code falls back to it unchanged when the model is off. Slots: {game} (short name), {gameFull}, {kills} (number), {killsText}, {result}, {weapon}, {mode}, {map}, {streamer}, {channel}, {community} (the last three come from the local profile at draft time; a line whose slot has no value is not used). {gameTag} {gameTag2} are the game's first hashtags (data/games/<id>/posting.json). Placeholders only: never write names, brands, channel ids or community codes here. Research and sources: docs/evidence/2026-11-27-post-text-reach.md. Numbers marked UNVERIFIED there are guesses.
